name: gh_pull_create
description: Create a pull request; the number is assigned from the repository's shared issue/PR sequence (POST /repos/{owner}/{repo}/pulls)

repo.description: The repository full name in owner/repo form.

title.description: The title of the new pull request.

head.description: The name of the branch where your changes are implemented.

base.description: The name of the branch you want the changes pulled into. Default: main.

body.description: The contents of the pull request.

draft.description: Indicates whether the pull request is a draft. Default: false.

user.description: Login of the PR author (the authenticated user in the real API). Default: revops-bot.
